baseFrontend: 7.9.74 scalar-dialog runtime with deterministic type-aware manual controls
notes: All writable states are handled according to their native data type: button, boolean switch, or scalar dialog.
Direct button and switch actions work in normal and expert mode; safety-relevant commands are expert-only.
Safety classification supports explicit NexoWatt metadata and conservative fallback patterns for reset, charging/current/power limits and setpoints.
Read-only states remain read-only and writes still pass through ioBroker ACL enforcement.
All active module-federation entrypoints use the cache-separated v75 runtime.
label: v75
changes: Button/trigger states write true directly regardless of expert mode when policy permits.
Writable boolean states toggle reliably even from null/string/number representations.
Writable number/string/enum/json states open the native ObjectBrowser value dialog.
Safety-relevant write states are disabled outside expert mode and visibly marked.
A central deduplicating write helper prevents accidental double commands.
